items.title: At least 169 people are killed when insurgents raid a village in Abiemnom County, Ruweng Administrative Area, South Sudan.

United States: 2026 Minab school attack: Win Without War protestors display children's backpacks on Capitol Hill in protest of theMinab elementary school airstrike that killed 160 children. Several Democrats from Congress attend the protest.
Kenya: 2026 Kenya floods: At least 108 people are killed after multiple weeks of flooding across the country.
United Kingdom: Hundreds of community events are held around the UK to mark five years since the outbreak of COVID-19 in the UK, which killed over 230,000 people.
Israel: Israel conducts extensive strikes across Gaza after accusing Hamas of rejecting hostage deal proposals from mediators, killing at least 400 people.

Russia: Crocus City Hall attack: At least 151 people are killed and 609 are injured in a shooting and arson attack claimed by the Islamic State in the Crocus City Hall music venue in Krasnogorsk, Moscow Oblast.
Kenya: March–May – 2024 Kenya floods: At least 238 people are killed nationwide in floods.
Ukraine: A theater in Mariupol where hundreds of people had taken shelter was bombed in a Russian air strike, killing around 300 people and trapping around 1,300 in the rubble.
Ukraine: The UN Human Rights office (OHCHR) released new numbers: 925 civilians were killed in Ukraine, but said actual figures were likely to be "considerably higher".
United Kingdom: The British coronavirus-related death toll rises to 199, while the number of confirmed cases of the illness rises to 4,457.

Mexico: A leak from a clandestine gasoline operation is detected in Tlahuelilpan, Hidalgo two months after the Tlahuelilpan pipeline explosion that left 135 dead.
Historical eruption: VEI 4, Manam, Papua New Guinea (2007-03-01)
Iraq: Two suicide bombers blew themselves up in a crowd of Shiite pilgrims streaming toward the holy city of Karbala killing at least 120 people and injuring more than 190.

Iraq: A series of deadly bomb attacks kills more than 100 people in Shia areas of Baghdad and the town of Khalis. Earlier, more than 40 people died and 80 were injured in three co-ordinated blasts in Khalis.
